bundle.shortDescription: Prep and in-round tools for policy debate
bundle.longDescription: Policy Debate is one place for preparing for policy debate rounds and for debating in them: flowing, timers, card cutting, blocks, and topicality. AI help is available in Prep and is switched off completely during a round.
